statement: For every real theta,c with 0<theta<1 and 0<c<(1-theta)/3, PrimeIntervalInput(theta) implies that for all sufficiently large natural k and every integer n with 2k<n<=exp(c*log(k)^2/log(log(k))), there is a prime p with k<p<2k dividing Pprod k n.

scoped_obstruction.class: LocationBlindTermwiseLeadingCertificate(theta,c): there exist rho,alpha,beta with rho>0, rho>=c, alpha>1, beta>1, and (2alpha+beta)rho<=1-theta.
scoped_obstruction.exact_block_invariant: (2r-1)log(T1)+(r-1)log(T2)=log(delta)+4log(W), for every r>=2 and arbitrary derivative factor and unbalanced lambda.
scoped_obstruction.W_monotonicity: W>=1 makes the invariant no smaller than log(delta).
scoped_obstruction.finite_safe_tail_budget: If log(delta W^4)>=-(1-theta)K-M-C and the separate budgets are log(T1)<=-alpha M, log(T2)<=-beta M, then ((2r-1)alpha+(r-1)beta)M<=(1-theta)K+M+C.
scoped_obstruction.endpoint_excess_budget: At c>=(1-theta)/3, if rM>=cK-DM and both logs are <=-M-q, then (3r-2)q<=(3D+3)M+C; the strict reverse inequality kernel-refutes simultaneous budgets. This finite form covers effective log-powers tending to 1 once the natural proof supplies q->infinity.
scoped_obstruction.subdivision_class: LocationBlindTermwiseSubdivisionAt is an arbitrary nonempty finite positive-weight full-tail family, with one common safe-tail loss C, one common conditional order loss D, and a summed nonnegative first-two ledger H*exp(-M-q).
scoped_obstruction.finite_extraction: candidate_cardinality_tail and candidate_half_mass_tail check the PI counting step; interval_partition_length_sum checks full-tail weights; locationBlindSubdivision_exists_good_block selects one block with both log terms <=-M-q, without any family-cardinality bound.
scoped_obstruction.finite_subdivision_no_go: At c>=(1-theta)/3, fixed-scale separation ((3D+3)M+C)M < (3cK-(3D+2)M)q rules out LocationBlindTermwiseSubdivisionAt. The statement is uniform in the finite index set and therefore applies pointwise to block counts growing arbitrarily with k.
scoped_obstruction.finite_source_geometry: SourceGeometrySubdivisionAt explicitly requires common a>0, En>=0 and ED>=0, x in [k,k+k^theta], r<=(1/2)k^(1-theta), a*k^(theta-1)/log(k)<=delta, endpoint scale >=exp(c*log(k)^2/loglog(k)-En), and derivative scale >=exp(-ED)*endpoint*factorial/x^(r+1). Lean maps it to LocationBlindTermwiseSubdivisionAt with C=-log(a) and D=5/2+En+ED.
scoped_obstruction.finite_source_endpoint_wrapper: For q>=1, cK>=0, (3D+2)M<=cK and ((3D+3)M+C)M<2cK, sourceGeometrySubdivision_endpoint_no_go_of_scale_bounds rules out the explicit source certificate at c>=(1-theta)/3.
scoped_obstruction.endpoint: The class is impossible for c>=(1-theta)/3; at theta=21/40 it is impossible for c>=19/120.
scoped_obstruction.formalization_boundary: Lean checks the finite PI cardinality tail, partition telescope, weighted extraction, exact block algebra, finite subdivision endpoint no-go, and the source-geometry map from explicit common raw constants a,En,ED to C=-log(a), D=5/2+En+ED. It does not infer common constants for arbitrary shifted/regrouped sources from unquantified asymptotic notation, nor package K/loglog(k)^2->infinity as a Lean sequence theorem. This is not a no-go for Erdos 451 or for all methods.

interpretation.balanced_lower_endpoint: The former theta>9/23 restriction is an artifact of balanced lambda and is removed by the adaptive construction.
interpretation.bhp_corollary: At theta=21/40 the theorem still gives every c<19/120; the unconditional BHP constant is not improved.
interpretation.erdos451_status: The Erdős 451 problem is not closed; this is a lower-bound theorem conditional on PrimeIntervalInput(theta), with BHP supplying theta=21/40.
